definitions.gloss: to promise, to make a commitment
definitions.explanation: To give one's word to do or not do something.

definitions.gloss: to make an appointment, to arrange to meet
definitions.explanation: To agree on a time and place to meet someone.

notes:
{約束|やくそく}する covers a broader range than English "promise." It is used for both solemn commitments and casual plans to meet.

SENSE 1 — PROMISE:
- {約束|やくそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to keep a promise
- {約束|やくそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}る→破る：02321_yaburu⟧: to break a promise
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{約束|やくそく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to promise (someone) that ~

SENSE 2 — APPOINTMENT/PLANS:
- {約束|やくそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have plans/an appointment
- {約束|やくそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: the agreed-upon time
- {約束|やくそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: the agreed-upon place
- ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{約束|やくそく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make plans with a friend

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {約束|やくそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}ける→取り付ける：06797_toritsukeru⟧: to secure a commitment/appointment
- {約束|やくそく}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧: as promised, as agreed

USAGE:
For formal or business appointments, ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧ (reservation) or ⟦アポ→アポ：06668_apo⟧ (from English "appointment") is more appropriate. {約束|やくそく} is typically used for informal agreements between individuals.
